text:
tess_support: FYI customer reported a spike of tool-call failures right after the v3.2 rollout. They see 400 schema validation errors and wrong tool selection (search_db chosen instead of patient_lookup). Ticket: https://redwood.zendesk/ACME-987

matt_eng: can you paste a sample request+response? logs? :eyes:

tess_support: here's a sanitized sample:
```
POST /v1/infer HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
{"model":"redwood-model-v3.2","input":"Find patient record for John Doe","functions":[{"name":"patient_lookup","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"patient_id":{"type":"string"}}}}],"temperature":0}
```

response:
```
{ "tool_chosen":"search_db", "args":{"q":12345}, "error":"schema validation failed: expected patient_id (string)" }
```

matt_eng: that looks like two issues: 1) model picked wrong tool, 2) args were coerced to number and name changed. can someone check if v3.2 changed toolcall interface logits or defaults?

rachel_ml: v3.2 includes a small change to system prompts and a tweak to tokenization that affects function-name tokenization. could change arg surface and tool logits. repro: run the same prompt with v3.1 and v3.2 - you'll see different function tokens. also seeing higher softmax mass on short function names -> picks "search_db" more often.

oliver_oncall: noticed this coincided with a deploy event. deploy-bot: "deploy started: service=tool-router image=tool-router:v3.2 by javier_prod"

deploy-bot: "canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% complete"

oliver_oncall: we also saw a transient auth 401 surge (prob unrelated) and a p95 latency bump between 12:03-12:09 which likely worsened retries and malformed payloads :rotating_light: 

javier_prod: customer impact is high, recommend rollback to v3.1 for tool-router to stop incorrect toolcalls. if support confirms >5% error rate for top 3 customers we rollback now.

matt_eng: agree. temporary mitigation: server-side normalization to compare tool name tokens case-insensitively and coerce numeric args to strings before schema validation. quick patch:
```
# pseudo
if tool_choice in alias_map: tool_choice = alias_map[tool_choice]
for k,v in args.items(): if schema[k].type=='string' and isinstance(v,int): args[k]=str(v)
```
but we should rollback while we test this properly.

oliver_oncall: initiating rollback now: `infractl release rollback --service=tool-router --to=tool-router:v3.1 --percent=100` . will monitor.

(5 minutes later)

oliver_oncall: rollback in progress. error rate down to 0.4% (was 7.8%), p95 latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

javier_prod: okay proceed with rollback. create follow-up postmortem. action items: 1) matt to PR server-side coercion + stricter schema reject, 2) rachel to run differential tool-selection tests during model onboarding, 3) ops to add a canary healthcheck that measures tool-selection drift and schema errors. assign owners.

matt_eng: creating PR #2419 with the coercion fallback and unit tests. also adding telemetry to emit tool_mismatch metrics.

rachel_ml: I'll add tool-selection checks to the model onboarding checklist and add a regression test comparing top-K tool logits between versions.

tess_support: updated ticket ACME-987, told customer we've rolled back and we're tracking root cause. keeping thread here for record. :thumbsup:
